item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Yusuf looking at a lamp flame through holes in three cardboard sheets P, Q and R. The holes lie on one straight line.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: He can see the flame because light travels along the straight path through the aligned holes.
options.B: He can still see the flame if the hole in Q is moved well off the straight path.
options.C: Light from the flame bends freely around the sheets, so hole alignment does not matter.
options.D: He can see the flame only when sheets P, Q and R are all removed.
